phase8_benchmark_comparison.overhead_analysis: The per-frame model inference inside ViralLens (single-frame batch size 1) executes at approximately 11.5 ms/frame on CPU, compared to 1.62 ms/frame measured during Phase 8 batch evaluation. For a standard 15-second Reel (15 frames), total shadow computation completes in 1.03 seconds entirely in background threads without blocking Stage C or competitor discovery.
